title: DOTr eyes removal of barriers at tollways
summary: The Department of Transportation will pilot the removal of barriers across expressways in the country to eliminate bottlenecks at toll plazas and reduce motorists’ travel time, Transportation…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation (DOTr) will pilot the removal of barriers across expressways in the country to eliminate bottlenecks at toll plazas and reduce motorists’ travel time, Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon announced yesterday.

Dizon said implementing a multi-lane free-flow system has become an “urgent national priority,” citing its potential to improve tollway efficiency, reduce fuel consumption and cut carbon emissions from vehicles idling at toll gates.
The DOTr has ordered toll companies to submit a comprehensive action plan and readiness assessment of their cashless payment infrastructure to the Toll Regulatory Board before Dec. 21.

The required submissions must include electronic toll collection penetration strategies, infrastructure and technology readiness, operational and enforcement protocols, as well as implementation timelines and milestones.

Dizon also advised toll companies to expand radio frequency identification (RFID) and electronic toll collection (ETC) installation sites, promote digital onboarding, offer promotional incentives and conduct public information campaigns.

Expressway operators were likewise directed to assess the readiness of their gantries, automatic number plate recognition cameras, high-speed RFID readers and system integration to support the planned transition.
Meanwhile, Dizon announced on Friday the DOTr would soon open the Cavite-Laguna Expressway (CALAX) and the South Luzon Expressway Toll Road 4 (SLEX TR4).
CALAX is 97 percent complete and President Marcos is expected to inaugurate it before Christmas, Dizon said.
“This was awarded in 2015, and now we’re going to finish it, finally,” he added.
The first phase of SLEX TR4, extending to Lucena, is expected to open early next year.
